definitions.explanation: The ability to hold a conversation — typically referring to skill in a foreign language, but also used for the social skill of conversing well with others. Commonly discussed in language study and communication training.

examples.japanese: {会話力|かいわりょく}を{高|たか}める。
{英語|えいご}の{会話力|かいわりょく}に{自信|じしん}がない。
examples.english: I'm not confident in my English conversation skills.

examples.japanese: {留学|りゅうがく}を{通|つう}じて{日本語|にほんご}の{会話力|かいわりょく}が{大幅|おおはば}に{伸|の}びた。
examples.english: My Japanese conversation skills improved dramatically through studying abroad.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}で{成功|せいこう}するには、{専門知識|せんもんちしき}だけでなく{会話力|かいわりょく}も{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
examples.english: To succeed at work, conversational ability is also important, not just specialized knowledge.

notes:
Compound of {会話|かいわ} ('conversation') and the suffix {力|りょく} ('ability; power'). The {力|りょく} suffix is highly productive and attaches to many nouns to form 'ability' words: {英語力|えいごりょく} ('English ability'), {読解力|どっかいりょく} ('reading comprehension'), {集中力|しゅうちゅうりょく} ('concentration'), {表現力|ひょうげんりょく} ('expressive ability').

USAGE:
Most often used in the context of foreign-language study, especially in expressions like {英語|えいご}の{会話力|かいわりょく} or {日本語|にほんご}の{会話力|かいわりょく}. Can also refer to the social/interpersonal skill of carrying a conversation, particularly in business training contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {会話力|かいわりょく}を{高|たか}める: to improve conversational ability
- {会話力|かいわりょく}を{伸|の}ばす: to extend/grow one's conversational ability
- {会話力|かいわりょく}を{身|み}につける: to acquire conversational skills
- {会話力|かいわりょく}がある: to have good conversational ability
- {会話力|かいわりょく}が{足|た}りない: to lack conversational ability
- {会話力|かいわりょく}テスト: conversation ability test

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {語学力|ごがくりょく}: language ability — broader; covers reading, writing, speaking, listening
- {英語力|えいごりょく}: English ability — specifically one language, across all four skills
- コミュニケーション{能力|のうりょく}: communication skills — even broader, includes non-verbal and written communication
- {話|はな}し{方|かた}: way of speaking — delivery and style, not skill level
- {対話力|たいわりょく}: dialogue skills — more formal, emphasizes two-way exchange
